description: Machine-readable release-assurance gates for requirement/citation recall, evidence precision, provenance completeness, and an explicit false-negative budget over the reviewed USPTO gold corpus.

requirement_recall.definition: True positives / (true positives + false negatives) over gold requirement_id set.
requirement_recall.numerator: count of gold requirements present in system output

citation_recall.definition: True positives / (true positives + false negatives) over gold legal citation strings (normalized).
citation_recall.numerator: count of gold citations present in system output

evidence_precision.definition: True positives / (true positives + false positives) over claimed evidence span links for requirements and assessments.
evidence_precision.numerator: count of predicted evidence links that match gold span anchors

provenance_completeness.definition: Fraction of extracted requirements, citations, dates, and facts that carry every required provenance field from matching.provenance_required_fields.
provenance_completeness.numerator: count of annotated items with complete provenance
provenance_completeness.denominator: count of annotated items requiring provenance

false_negative_budget.definition: False negatives / gold positives for government requirements on the reviewed corpus. Explicit budget for missed demands (OCR/parser misses).
false_negative_budget.numerator: count of gold requirements absent from system output
false_negative_budget.notes: Complement of requirement_recall at the same matching policy; both gates must pass.
